name: Evans Electric Ltd.
summary: Evans Electric Ltd. offers extensive electro-mechanical repair and maintenance services for a broad spectrum of electrical machinery, encompassing all brands, sizes, and capacities. Their comprehensive solutions address low and high voltage AC/DC electric motors, various generators (including turbo and hydro generator stators, rotors, and field poles), and transformers. Additionally, the company provides specialized services such as dynamic balancing, vacuum impregnation, high-voltage coil manufacturing, reliability-centered maintenance (RLA) studies, vibration reduction, advanced diagnostic testing, precision machining, fabrication, and other allied support. Established in 1951 by Armando F. De Souza, Silus L. Evans, R. Pinto, Anslekar D’Mello, and E. R. D’ Mello, the firm is based in Mumbai, India.
